title: ROI / P&L extraction (Projects-owned, ledger read isolated)
statusScope: PRJ-04 as redefined by decision D2' (below): Projects keeps its own project-level ROI and P&L and receipts, extracted into domain/application/security/infrastructure; its single Finance table read is isolated and recorded. This is NOT the roadmap's original PRJ-04 ('call finance/application's P&L use case'); that plan was found non-equivalent in PRJ-01 and D2's replacement was superseded. Typecheck, build and tests ran in a scratch copy installed with --no-frozen-lockfile; the repo's own frozen install still fails. Parity was shown against a fake database, not real Postgres or the real PDF renderer.

decision.summary: Projects owns project-level ROI/P&L and public receipts. The one read of finance_ledger_entries lives in projects/infrastructure/repositories/project-ledger-reader.ts (raw SUM per kind, no conversion). No Finance code changed; Projects imports nothing from Finance; PRJ-04 does not depend on Finance's WP-8/WP-9 pack.
decision.trigger: Project owner asked why Projects' ROI/P&L, which was written separately for projects, should move into Finance.
decision.note: Taken on the owner's question and implemented as the lowest-risk reading. The original D2 (Finance-owned per-project use case) remains possible later; it would change who owns the receipt arithmetic.

oldToNewMapping.old: routes/projects.ts fmtPublicProjectReceipt and the inline PDF layout object
routes/projects.ts receipt queries (find/insert/delete/by token, issuer name)

filesChangedThisPhase: artifacts/api-server/src/routes/projects.ts (5 handlers thinned, 1108 -> 985 lines; crypto and three table imports removed)
behaviorPreserved: All 47 route paths, methods, middleware chains and registration order unchanged; PEP audit actions project_pnl_receipt.view and .pdf still pinned.
No rounding and no currency conversion: sums are plain doubles of the stored amounts; receipts still print '$' regardless of currency.
roiPct: null only with no spend and no earnings; 100 for earnings without spend; a stored entity ROI of 0 is kept.
Mint stays idempotent with up to 3 attempts on a token collision, then 500 'Could not generate a receipt link, please try again'; revoke deletes the row.
Handlers keep their try/catch layout (roi-summary and mint have one; revoke and the public routes do not).
The comment claiming the receipt is 'kept in lockstep' with GET /finance/investments was removed because it was untrue; the replacement comment states the difference.

commands.command: negative tests P1-P7 (ledger read back in route, second ledger reader, Projects imports Finance, token generator redeclared, public PEP action removed, rogue receipt-table writer, restored)
commands.result: Each produced FAIL with the expected finding; restored copy PASS.

commands.command: differential test, ROI + receipts: original handlers (sliced verbatim) vs current, fake DB, deterministic crypto stub, PDF spec captured
commands.result: 35 scenarios, 35 identical (status, body, receipt rows, captured PDF specs); statuses 200/400/401/404/500; PDF specs captured in 3 scenarios.

commands.command: harness sensitivity: six mutations of the new bundle (roiPct formula, earned-only roiPct, '$' prefix, mint attempts, ?? to ||, rounding invested)
commands.result: All six detected (3, 2, 3, 1, 1 and 3 scenarios differed). The first seed data missed two of them (could not tell ?? from ||, and could not see rounding on a whole-number amount); the seed data was strengthened and the check repeated.
30 tests, 30 pass (dates 4, ratings 3, templates 5, project 6, raw sets 3, roi 4, pnl-receipt 3, receipt-token 2)

checkedAndCleared: ledger amount is doublePrecision, so SUM returns a JS number and 'invested += r.total' does not concatenate strings.

notRun.reason: Unchanged since PRJ-01: lockfile overrides mismatch. Scratch results use a non-frozen resolution.

notRun.check: repo-level pnpm typecheck (all artifacts and scripts)

notRun.reason: No test database; parity shown against a fake DB.
Stubbed in the differential test; only the layout spec handed to it was compared.
PRJ-04 no longer depends on Finance code; the pack is still BLOCKED per finance evidence and still gates any future Finance-owned P&L.

openQuestions: Should project receipts convert to base currency like /finance/investments? Not decided; current behavior is pinned by tests.
Confirm D2' (it was taken on the owner's question, not an explicit instruction).
Receipts label every amount with '$' whatever currency the ledger rows used; a user with non-USD rows sees a mislabeled figure. Pre-existing, pinned, not fixed.
carriedFromPriorPhases: PRJ-ISSUE-2 (POST /projects may 500 after creating, unconfirmed on a real DB) preserved
orphan rows after project delete unchecked
entities.ts and services/sync.ts still write entity_project_roi outside the module
nextSafeStep: PRJ-05 (enrollment, Vault-coupled, plus legacy retirement). It is the highest-risk phase: three enrollment write paths (enroll, teams, bulk) and the frozen PEP wiring. Before it, confirm PRJ-ISSUE-2 and D2' and fix the repo install so a real baseline exists.
